title: Local coding CLI model catalog
description: Generated catalog of model ids, aliases, defaults, and tier menus accepted by local coding CLIs.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this catalog was generated.

sources.description: Audit trail for every source used by the updater.

providers.description: Provider/CLI-specific model catalogs. Only providers whose CLI is installed on the generating machine are present.

cli.description: CLI/provider key used by loader helpers.

binary.description: Expected executable name for the local CLI.

default_model.description: Default model or alias for this CLI.

default_tier.description: Default reasoning tier, or an empty string for CLIs without tiers.

tier_options.description: Union of supported reasoning tiers exposed by this CLI.

model_string_format.description: Optional combined model/tier format used by consumers such as Codex UIs.

aliases.description: Provider-level aliases mapped to model ids or other aliases.

models.description: Models and alias rows accepted by the CLI.

dispatch.description: How to hand work to this CLI from the wrappers (curated in overlay.toml): whether the CLI reads files from the working directory, the prompt-argument limit, and free-text notes.

reads_workspace.description: The CLI can open files in the working directory itself; pass paths, not contents.

prompt_arg_limit_bytes.description: Above this size the wrapper pipes the prompt through stdin instead of an argument.

id.description: Canonical model id or explicit CLI variant id.

aliases.description: Accepted aliases that resolve to this model id.

tiers.description: Reasoning tiers accepted for this model.

default_tier.description: Default reasoning tier for this model, or empty string when none exists.

context_window.description: Context window in tokens when known.

knowledge.description: Knowledge cutoff when upstream reports it.

last_updated.description: Upstream metadata last-updated date when known.

pricing.description: Pricing metadata copied from upstream when available.

visible.description: Whether this row is part of the user-facing CLI menu.

deprecated.description: Whether upstream marks the model as deprecated.

migration.description: Replacement model id when a local CLI reports a migration.

source.description: Primary source that produced this row.

fetched_at.description: Timestamp attached to the row's primary source.
